name: Reminder
description: Reminders tied to a thing at a time: remind the user to do something with an object, or what is due.
examples: Remind me to water the plant at 5
What do I need to bring tomorrow?
Did I have a reminder about the oven?
note: Foundational MOD defined as a spec (modos-system-design.md 5.3): the system can choose it and its text answers; its selectors and representations are not implemented yet.

default.label: Highlight the thing
